$comment: Prototir module registry seed (D22). Served to the CDN as /modules/registry.json. kinds: lib (third-party runtime), model (weights pack), prefab (Prototir-built drop-in scaffold), template (official forkable starter prototype), capability (SDK-brokered platform feature, not a download). status: available (servable today) | planned (catalogued, not yet built/vendored). License gate: MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD/ISC only (LGPL case-by-case, served unmodified); AGPL never. Sizes are approximate gzipped KB.

modules.name: three
modules.blurb: 3D rendering — the workhorse for game/art prototypes.

modules.name: pixi
modules.blurb: Fast 2D WebGL renderer.

modules.name: phaser
modules.blurb: Batteries-included 2D game framework (scenes, tilemaps, arcade physics).

modules.name: p5
modules.blurb: Creative coding. Served unmodified (LGPL case-by-case).

modules.name: rapier3d
modules.blurb: 3D physics (WASM). Pairs with three.

modules.name: matter
modules.blurb: Lightweight 2D physics (no WASM).

modules.name: howler
modules.blurb: Audio playback / sprites.

modules.name: tone
modules.blurb: Web Audio synthesis & scheduling.

modules.name: meyda
modules.blurb: Real-time audio feature extraction (for audio-reactive visuals).

modules.name: lil-gui
modules.blurb: Tiny tweak-panel for exposing prototype parameters.

modules.name: motion
modules.blurb: Animation library (vanilla Motion One API). GSAP excluded: proprietary license forbids self-CDN redistribution.

modules.name: chart
modules.blurb: Charts for dashboard/tool prototypes.

modules.name: d3
modules.blurb: Data-driven documents for bespoke viz.

modules.name: simplex-noise
modules.blurb: Procedural noise.

modules.name: seedrandom
modules.blurb: Deterministic RNG — reproducible runs, fair challenge leaderboards.

modules.name: onnxruntime-web
modules.blurb: ONNX inference runtime (WASM + WebGPU) — the base for model packs.

modules.name: transformers
modules.blurb: Pipelines over ONNX: detection, segmentation, depth, ASR, embeddings.

modules.name: mediapipe-vision
modules.blurb: Hands / pose / face landmarks — realtime body-driven interaction.

modules.name: model-rfdetr-nano
modules.blurb: RF-DETR nano object detection weights — real-time DETR in the browser. (YOLOv8 excluded: AGPL.)

modules.name: model-whisper-tiny
modules.blurb: Local speech-to-text — voice-controlled prototypes with zero API cost.

modules.name: model-depth-anything-small
modules.blurb: Monocular depth from the webcam — parallax/AR-ish effects.

modules.name: prefab-fps-rig
modules.blurb: Pointer-lock FPS controller: WASD strafe + mouse look, capsule physics, jump/sprint — pass a prefab-input handle for two-stick touch controls.

modules.name: prefab-thirdperson-rig
modules.blurb: Follow-camera third-person rig with gamepad/touch input.

modules.name: prefab-webcam-cv
modules.blurb: getUserMedia loop + model session + canvas overlay + FPS meter — point a detector at the world in ~20 lines.

modules.name: prefab-hand-controls
modules.blurb: Hand landmarks → pointer/pinch/grab events; drive any prototype by hand.

modules.name: prefab-voice-input
modules.blurb: Push-to-talk → local transcript events.

modules.name: prefab-ai-npc
modules.blurb: Conversational NPC on Prototir.ai: persona prompt + rolling memory + typed reply events.

modules.name: prefab-input
modules.blurb: One input API for desktop and mobile: keyboard, or fully customizable virtual controls — any number of buttons/joysticks/d-pads with position, size, shape and short/long-press semantics; same axes/pressed()/onPress() reads either way.

modules.name: prefab-shader-canvas
modules.blurb: Full-screen fragment shader boilerplate: uniforms for time/mouse/resolution.

modules.name: template-3d-thirdperson
modules.blurb: Forkable starter: playable 3D scene, score wired to Prototir.score.

modules.name: template-webcam-detector
modules.blurb: Forkable starter: live object detection with labeled overlay.

modules.name: template-ai-chat-toy
modules.blurb: Forkable starter: a character you talk to; demoes AI quota UX.

modules.name: capability-ai
modules.source: Prototir.ai via Player Shell postMessage → platform proxy
modules.blurb: Brokered LLM access (chat/complete). The sandbox has connect-src 'none'; AI calls hop through the shell to a platform-metered, moderated proxy. Tier-gated quotas.

modules.name: capability-storage
modules.blurb: Per-prototype key-value persistence. Opaque-origin iframes have no reliable localStorage; the shell stores it namespaced per prototype (and per user when signed in).

modules.name: capability-permissions
modules.blurb: Camera/microphone: declared in prototir.json, granted via iframe allow= after an explicit shell-level user consent prompt.
